text: うみで　ポケモン　つれば　もっと　あつまり　そうじゃ！

structure.jp: うみで　ポケモン　つれば
structure.en: if you fish for Pokémon in the sea

structure.jp: もっと　あつまり　そうじゃ！
structure.en: it looks like more will gather!

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: Changing a verb's ending to the え-row plus ば means 'if'. つる 'fish' becomes つれば = 'if you fish'.

patterns.name: 〜そうだ
patterns.span: あつまり　そうじゃ
patterns.explanation: そう after the short form of a verb says 'it looks like it will'; じゃ is the old-man だ. あつまり　そうじゃ = 'it looks like they'll gather'.
